name: Anafa Cohen
title: Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
tagline: Senior Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
bio: With 7+ years of experience in computer vision and applied machine learning, I work on problems involving imagery, video, audio, and other sensor data — from the first experiment to a solution that actually works in production.

statement: I'm a machine learning engineer who enjoys turning messy, real-world data into working algorithms.

roles.title: Senior Computer Vision & Deep Learning Engineer

projects.title: Closed-Vocabulary Object Detection Pipeline
projects.blurb: A closed-vocabulary object detection module built on Co-DETR, with a benchmarking framework to guide model and threshold decisions.
projects.description: Designed and implemented a closed-vocabulary object detection module based on a Co-DETR pre-trained model, including a full benchmarking and evaluation pipeline. Built a comprehensive benchmarking framework to evaluate model performance and guide architectural and threshold-level decisions.
bullets: Co-DETR-based object detection module for a closed vocabulary of target classes
End-to-end benchmarking and evaluation pipeline built alongside the model
Benchmarking framework used to guide architectural and threshold-level decisions

Systematic threshold tuning across the pipeline
Ablation studies to isolate what improved performance

projects.title: Speaker Recognition & Cross-Video Retrieval
projects.blurb: A speaker recognition and retrieval pipeline for finding the same speakers across large video datasets
projects.description: Designed an evaluation framework for a speaker recognition system aimed at cross-video speaker retrieval.
bullets: Investigated the pipeline from video/audio processing through speaker diarization, embedding generation, vector indexing, and retrieval
Designed and built an initial benchmark to establish reliable ground truth for evaluation and validated the end-to-end retrieval flow.
Guided and validated a team of annotators in the speaker-matching annotation process to ensure consistent and reliable ground truth
Defined a roadmap for larger-scale evaluation, including retrieval metrics, similarity thresholds, false-positive/false-negative analysis, and robustness to challenging audio conditions

projects.title: Automatic Production Optimization for American Football Broadcasts
projects.blurb: Real-time computer vision improvements to game state detection for automatic American Football broadcast production.
projects.description: Developed real-time computer vision algorithms for automatic sports broadcast production, with a focus on improving game state detection in American Football videos — analyzing failure modes of existing algorithms and incorporating motion-based and spatial metrics. Prototyped in Python and deployed optimized solutions in C++ for real-time performance.
bullets: Improved game state detection via failure-mode analysis of existing algorithms
Incorporated motion-based and spatial metrics into detection
Prototyped in Python, deployed in C++ for real-time performance
